runtimeDependencies: Browser WebGL 2 and module Workers; no external package runtime
optionalInputBridge: dynamic-regional.mjs reads caller-provided generated regional world
surfaceWaterInputBridge: fromDynamicRegionalWater reads caller-provided flowReceiver, riverMask and basin fields; preserves source IDs and completes downstream paths
surfaceWaterModel: new static game channel-fit implementation; explicit water body levels; no source display-curve code copied
auditRepair: 0.2.1 adds clipped open regional cuts, simple concave bodies, explicit water-grid roles, road diagnostics, shared construction work and verified legacy water compatibility
fieldRefinement: 0.2.2 bounded tensor Hermite C1 ground interpolation and surface derivatives; 0.3.1 also connects finite C1 base ground to static channels and explicit surface grids using cropped Bezier hulls and degree-six segment extrema
auditIntegration: 0.3.1 adds projected surface traces and road diagnostics with unknown-water counts and regional identity, shared trace budgets, C1 bank/body revalidation, and numerical-cut regression coverage; carved triangle-strip ground is not guaranteed C1
channelSizing: 0.2.2 optional capped Strahler heuristic preserving source order and propagating effective order through completed drainage; not calibrated discharge
automaticWaterBodies: deferred by explicit user instruction; no inferred sea datum or terminal lakes
globalInputBridge: 0.3.0 reads generated geography-lite physical arrays, macro IDs and feature memberships; does not call its generator or alter original source files
globalImplementation: new canonical spherical field using periodic padded Hermite and polar caps, fixed bounded Cartesian detail bands, explicit radius/datum offset, and azimuthal-equidistant regional views
globalWaterImplementation: 0.3.2 single caller-defined water chart directly over the same canonical sphere; shared profile solver and JSON contract; spherical Lipschitz probe bounds; explicit datum and continuous profile center incision gate revalidated on restore; original point ground passed directly to carving; same-projection mesh/body/coverage events
globalWaterVerification: Saved geography-lite audit-a/audit-b inputs with eight independent caller-defined confluence charts and a synthetic internal-shore lake fixture; generator-free separate-process exact frame, sample and road comparisons; source snapshots preserved
projectedCanonicalExport: 0.3.3 explicit base projected-view grid export with distinct finite-world identity, inherited datum and per-cell original source cell/basin/outlet/macro/feature references; centers exact, interpolation approximate; caller-defined surface or groundwater inputs; no local drainage recomputation
globalConstructionReuse: 0.3.3 one fitted compile per new construction reused by sampler; restore compiles saved widths once and revalidates support and center incision; old saved worlds unchanged
adaptiveProjectedBounds: 0.3.3 spherical-lipschitz-adaptive-probes@2 budgets each rectangle or segment to 262144 probes using actual-spacing uncertainty; old spherical-lipschitz-probes@1 restores original fixed-budget behavior
boundaryOutflow: 0.3.3 incoming-tangent-or-outward-normal@1 infers boundary rays from active incoming drainage, weights by original accumulation when available, and records authority; directional strip open cuts@3 extend endpoint sections before clipping; old strip@2 retained
sharedPrimitives: 0.3.3 strict JSON copies, insertion-order-preserving canonical clones, periodic Hermite ghost columns, trace completion and verifier test-file lists shared; raw undefined/nonfinite metadata rejected
smoothChannelBanks: 0.3.4 strip-with-smooth-banks@4 uses cubic smoothstep influence to match the base outer-bank normal derivative; rejects same-edge positive-area wet-triangle self-overlap; interior triangles, centerlines, bends, caps and junction/min composition not guaranteed C1; old construction contracts retained
anchoredGlobalDetail: 0.3.4 anchored-spherical-residual-bands@2 subtracts a periodic Hermite/polar-cap interpolation of source-center noise from Cartesian spherical noise; preserves source heights and fixed amplitude bound; grid-line/polar detail no longer suppressed; distinct worldId and analytic gradient bound; local four-corner envelope and recomputed drainage not promised
multipleGlobalCharts: 0.3.4 global-water-terrain@2 holds up to 16 explicit disjoint charts over one saved base sphere and shared runtime sampler; base normalization once per build/restore; conservative spherical-cap or same-axis rectangle separation; chart/source IDs namespaced in samples; shared-projection trace events; overlapping charts and cross-chart connected rivers rejected
centerIncisionReuse: 0.3.4 conservative segment probes also collect endpoint incision values; interval bound and vertex diagnostic remain independently checked without a second ground-reference loop
surfaceDerivatives: normal/curvature arithmetic shared by finite regional adapters and projected spherical views; old C1 saved frames retain exact values
legacyCompatibilityFixture: fixtures/terrain-v1.snapshot.json is the unchanged stage-1 world-a adapter snapshot
